title: Reach: a free investor CRM and outreach tool for crypto raises
content_html:
Raising capital in crypto means reaching a lot of the right people without letting any of them fall through the cracks. Reach is a free investor outreach and CRM app built for exactly that, and it comes with your Cryptool account.

What Reach is

Reach helps crypto teams find the right investors and partners, send personalized outreach at scale, and track every reply and follow-up in one pipeline. Instead of juggling spreadsheets and inboxes, your whole raise lives in one place.

Why a spreadsheet is not enough

  • You lose track of who you contacted, when, and what they said.
  • Follow-ups slip, and warm leads go cold.
  • There is no single view of the raise, so you cannot see what is working.

A generic CRM solves some of this, but it is built for sales teams, not crypto raises, and it is another tool to pay for and log into. Reach is built around how token projects, funds, and syndicates actually approach investors, and it shares one login with the rest of Cryptool.

What you can do with Reach

  • Build targeted lists of the investors and partners that fit your raise.
  • Send personalized outreach that reads one to one, to many contacts at once.
  • Track opens, replies, and follow-ups so nothing is forgotten.
  • Keep contacts, messages, and status together in one pipeline.

Who it is for

Token projects raising capital, funds and syndicates managing LP relationships, and founders running partnership and business-development outreach.

Getting started

Open Reach with your Cryptool account, build a list of investors and partners, and start sending personalized outreach. If you do not have an account yet, you can create one free in under a minute.

Try it: https://cryptool.io/reach
